Name: CP - catmao's interface collection
Author: luyepiaofeng
Description:
[font=Times New Roman][quote]catmao的界面mod都是png和xnb文件，可惜这很不方便。 catmao在评论中有提到她不知道如何制作cp mod，所以她允许任何人制作它们，幸运的是，我在一小时内制作成美化cp mod！
catmao's interface mods are only available in png and xnb files, which are not ideal and would require extra work. catmao mentioned in a comment that they don't know how to make cp mods so they allow anyone to make it, fortunately, i did managed to make this into a replacement cp mod within an hour![/quote]
﻿[size=3]请确保您从catmao下载所需的原始文件然后解压去“assets”文件夹里。这是“loosesprites”里的cursors、specialordersboards、junimonote和billboard的xnb文件 (\Stardew Valley\Content\LooseSprites) 和“minigames”里的titlebutoons的xnb文件 (\Stardew Valley\Content\Minigames\TitleButtons.xnb)的美化mod，所以请确保这不会被另一个美化mod冲突。这mod是在1.6和smapi 4.0.0+用，所以还请确保这两都更新到最新版本（但如果您正在玩旧版本的游戏和smapi，您也可以尝试）。
ensure that you download the required original files from catmao and extract them into the “assets" folder. this is a replacement mod that replaces cursors, specialordersboards, junimonote & billboard xnb files in "loosesprites" (\Stardew Valley\Content\LooseSprites) and titlebuttons xnb file in "minigames" (\Stardew Valley\Content\Minigames\TitleButtons.xnb). so please ensure that this does not conflict with another replacement mod that affects these interfaces. this mod is created for 1.6 and smapi 4.0.0+, so please also ensure that both are updated to the latest for this to work (but you can try if you're playing the older version of the game and smapi).[/size][/font][center][font=Times New Roman][size=4]
